featureFlag.title: Feature flags
featureFlag.description: Features still on trial: enable them for trial tenants first, open them to everyone once stable, then remove the flag along with the old code. Setting a flag to “Kill switch” turns it off for every tenant, overriding each tenant's own setting. Per-tenant settings are on the tenant detail page.

confirm.title: Change “{{key}}” for all tenants
confirm.default: Remove the platform-wide override: each tenant goes back to its own setting, or the default if it has none.
confirm.on: Turn it on for every tenant. Tenants that turned it off stay off.
confirm.off: Turn it off for every tenant right away, including trial tenants. Users lose the feature immediately.
